thread:
neha-partnerships: Heads-up — ACMECloud's Azure Marketplace purchase order flow is failing at ingest. Procurement is refusing to sign because the marketplace returned a tax_jurisdiction mismatch AND our vendor alias doesn't map. Acme's procurement wants an EDI 850 payload (not just a PDF) and won't accept manual entry as the primary path. Also Acme legal redlined the MSA: asking for an indemnity carveout + a 24/7 support SLA. Joint announcement is planned for Friday. @alexa-procurement @ashley-legal can we triage and surface a go/no-go? :eyes:

marketplace-bot: PO ingest failure for external_id=PO-ACME-7890, status=422, error_key=INVALID_TAX_JURISDICTION, details="billing_entity_id not found for jurisdiction 'GB-ISLE'"

alexa-procurement: Copy — can someone drop the full PO payload and the vendor alias name? if we have EIN and vendor id I can try manual entry to unblock revenue temporarily (48h window) but legal needs to sign off for a manual exception. :handshake:

Derek-sales: PO number is PO-ACME-7890, EIN 12-3456789. Vendor alias is "redwood-inc-uk" (legacy alias). We really need the announcement to go live Friday — marketing is lined up. Any chance legal can accept a provisional workaround? :pray:

ashley-legal: Saw the redlines. We can't accept an open indemnity carveout. Proposed compromise: 1) Mutual indemnity, limited to third-party IP and gross negligence, 2) Support SLA: business-hours + 4-hour severity-1 response, with credits for missed SLA. We can offer 24/7 for premium support add-on, but not baked into standard MSA. I'll prepare a tracked-change PDF and share a short summary. If procurement still insists on 24/7 as a term of the PO, escalate to Acme counterparty for negotiation.

sam-engineering: Technical notes — vendor alias mapping is a quick config flip in the marketplace portal OR we can add an alias mapping table on our side. The TAX jurisdiction validation comes from Azure's ledger validation step. If we normalize the jurisdiction to 'GB' instead of 'GB-ISLE' it should pass. Minimal patch: map 'GB-ISLE' -> 'GB' at ingest layer. I can push a hotfix to staging and promote to prod in ~3–6 hours if someone grants me access to the marketplace tenant (or if @alexa can request Azure support ticket).

alexa-procurement: I can run manual entry today if legal signs the exception. Also I can open an EDI enablement ticket with Acme's procurement team to accept a PDF fallback for onboarding within the portal. ETA for EDI enablement is ~5 business days though. If we want Friday announcement, manual entry + alias mapping + legal compromise is the only viable path.

neha-partnerships: Plan proposal: 1) Ashley to send the counter-proposal summary by EOD (legal owner). 2) Sam to do alias mapping hotfix and test in staging (engineering owner). 3) Alexa to do manual entry & open EDI ticket (procurement owner). 4) Derek to pause the announcement if any blocker persists by Thursday noon. Please confirm owners and callouts.

Derek-sales: Confirmed — I'll tell marketing to hold if we're not green by Thu 12:00 PT. I'll also ping Acme directly on the indemnity ask.

ashley-legal: Will share the 3-point summary in 30m. If Acme pushes 24/7 as a gating term, escalate to me and I will propose a signed addendum for premium support.

sam-engineering: On it — will request tenant access and post a staging link here once alias mapping patch is up.

alexa-procurement: I'll queue the manual entry now and call Acme procurement to confirm they won't rescind PO.

neha-partnerships: Thanks all. tagging for visibility: @derek-sales @ashley-legal @sam-engineering @alexa-procurement — please update thread with status. If anyone needs me to join a quick sync with Acme procurement/legal, I can do a 15m call this afternoon. :phone:
